own_solution.law: Closed-open pipe resonance L + e = (2n+1) lambda/4, lambda = v/f; successive resonances differ in length by lambda/2; time = (lambda/2)/u

notes: lambda = 343/512 = 0.669922 m; lambda/2 = 0.334961 m; t = 0.334961/0.015 = 22.331 s; with rate 2.4 cm/s, t = 13.957 s. Initial column length (130 cm) fixes which resonance comes first but cancels in the spacing (C). Inner radius sets the end correction (about 0.6 r), which is fixed and cancels in the difference (C); one could also call it K (plane-wave regime, ka about 0.24 well below cutoff), but its primary role is through the cancelling end correction. Rate sentences on the tube modify the base text's 'constant 1.5 cm/s'; as additions they read as updates, not contradictions, since the rate is constant over the resonances in each case. Pond sentences are D. T3D7A and TB8E5 carry no number ('small amount') unlike their 0.9 cm/s counterparts.
